bugs_found: apply_fee returns amount + fee instead of amount - fee, charging the fee to the customer additively rather than deducting it as the comment indicates
transfer is not atomic: no locking/transaction; concurrent transfers can cause race conditions and inconsistent balances
compound_interest does not validate that principal is non-negative
compound_interest performs r / n with Decimal division which may lose precision (non-terminating decimals) without explicit context/rounding
loan_payment final division can produce non-terminating Decimal for typical rates and may raise InexactError or lose precision without explicit quantize/context
fx_convert accepts rates as float via Decimal(str(rate)) but does not validate rate > 0 (zero or negative rates accepted)
fx_convert does not attempt inverse rate lookup or triangulation when direct pair missing
transfer mutates account balances before constructing Receipt with no rollback on later failure
Decimal results are never quantized to currency precision (e.g. 2 decimals), leading to sub-cent residues in monetary outputs
loan_payment allows principal == 0 returning 0 silently which may mask caller bugs
apply_fee does not coerce/validate that fee_pct is a fraction (e.g. >1 accepted, so 50 means 5000%)
Account.balance and Receipt.amount typed as Decimal but constructors accept any type with no validation/coercion
